answer: Every identity registers by locking 400 POA for 60 epochs, 100% slashed on proven duplication — a cedar stake that cannot be split or moved while it earns grading seats. Each attestation inherits a grading duty: one answer owes one grading seat, and clones may never grade kin, so a fake vouching for its own orchard of sockpuppets is caught when the cipher behind the cluster, the shared funding signature, appears twice. Auditors sweep the public ledger in seconds and freeze the cluster on third reveal. Each fake costs 400 POA locked 60 epochs; 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 POA.
